name: Create Multi-Channel Fluorescence Montage
description:
Create a publication-quality figure panel from a multi-channel microscopy image.

1. Open the built-in 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Fluorescent Cells).
2. Split the image into its constituent Red, Green, and Blue channels (Image > Color > Split Channels).
3. Create a montage that displays all 3 individual channels PLUS the original composite image (4 panels total).
   - You may need to combine them into a Stack first (Image > Stacks > Images to Stack).
   - Create the montage using Image > Stacks > Make Montage.
   - Layout can be 2x2, 1x4, or 4x1.
4. Save the final montage as a TIFF file to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/fluorescence_montage.tif'.

The final image must contain all 4 views combined into a single image file.
